description: Human-readable contract for data/<slug>.json. Enforcement lives in tools/generate.py (validate_game); this file exists so editors can validate and so contributors can read the schema without reading the validator.

scope_note.description: State the scope honestly, especially for partial trackers.

group.description: Counters sharing a group share one value; different achievements in one group may have different targets.

media.description: Optional screenshots/clips under the route note. Images render as , clips as

credit.description: Rendered as an 'Image: …' line under the image, e.g. the guide the image came from.

full.description: Optional larger version the image links to (opens in a new tab); same assets/ or https:// rules as src.

src.description: Repo file under assets/ (rendered one level up from a game page) or an https:// URL.

missable.description: True when the achievement can be passed without popping (a choice, a one-time window). Renders a Missable pill on the card.

filter_label.description: Label for the phase filter button. Preferred over the FILTER_LABELS fallback in tools/generate.py.

subtitle.description: On an achievement section, replaces the computed 'N achievements, XG' summary.

slug.description: Must match the filename (without .json) and be URL-safe.

storage_key.description: localStorage key for this game's progress. Changing it orphans existing saves.

total_count.description: Must equal the number of achievements across all sections.

total_gs.description: Must equal the sum of all achievement gs values.

title: Achievement tracker game
